title: NEGF
description: Solve lead-injection equations for a square-lattice device with the built-in UnitaryLab SDK QSVT solver, then compute transmission, local density of states, and bond current.

params.name: L
params.help: Number of scattering-region sites along x. The matrix dimension is L * W.

params.name: W
params.description: Device and lead width in lattice sites
params.help: Number of sites along y. ENERGY is computed from the midpoint of the first two transverse subband thresholds for this width.

params.name: a
params.help: Use a positive lattice constant for the intended square-lattice model.

params.name: t
params.help: Use a positive hopping energy scale for the intended model. The onsite energy is 4 * t and nearest-neighbor hopping is -t.

params.name: inverse_tolerance
params.help: Must satisfy 0 < inverse_tolerance < 1. This calibrates the SDK epsilon against the reciprocal polynomial relative error and does not guarantee the final linear-system residual.
